commentaries.author: वामन-जयादित्यौ
commentaries.content: वेञ इत्यनुवर्तते। ल्यपि च परतो वेञः संप्रसारणं न भवति। प्रवाय। उपवाय। पृथग्योगकरणमुत्तरार्थम्॥

commentaries.author: भट्टोजिदीक्षितः
commentaries.content: वेञो ल्यपि सम्प्रसारणं न स्यात् । प्रवाय ॥

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content: The semi-vowel of वे 'to weave' is not vocalised in the Participial affix ल्यप् follows. Thus प्रवाय, उपवाय ॥ The separation of this sutra from the last, is for the sake of the subsequent sutras, into which the anuvritti of ल्यप् only runs.

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content: The semi-vowel of वे 'to weave' is not vocalised in the Participial affix ल्यप् follows.
